bell.title: Notifications
bell.label: {count, plural, =0 {Notifications} other {Notifications, # unread}}
bell.empty: Nothing yet. You hear here when something needs you, such as a customer opening a link you shared.
bell.impersonating: You see {name}'s notifications. Only they can mark them read.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.intro: Your bell always shows what happened. Choose what also reaches you by email, and as a push notification on devices where you turn push on.
preferences.kindWins: A choice for one kind of notification wins over Everything.

everything.label: Everything
everything.hint: Every kind of notification, unless you choose otherwise for one below.

shareLinkOpened.label: A customer opens a link you shared
shareLinkOpened.hint: Repeat opens of the same link are held back for a while.

leadAssigned.label: A lead is given to you
leadAssigned.hint: When someone else makes you a lead's owner.

leadSlowReply.label: A new lead waits too long
leadSlowReply.hint: For everyone who can assign leads: when a new lead has had no reply within the time set in Lead assignment.

leadUnassigned.label: A new lead has no owner
leadUnassigned.hint: For everyone who can assign leads: when a new lead lands in Unassigned because nobody could take it.

leadRepeatEnquiry.label: A customer asks again
leadRepeatEnquiry.hint: When a repeat enquiry is added to one of your open leads.

leadImported.label: Leads from an import are given to you
leadImported.hint: When someone else imports a file that makes you the owner of some of its leads.

leadSheetAdded.label: Many leads from a Google Sheet are given to you
leadSheetAdded.hint: When a connected sheet brings you more than five leads at once, in one message. Fewer arrive one by one, as "A lead is given to you".

sheetNeedsAttention.label: A Google Sheet needs attention
sheetNeedsAttention.hint: When a connected sheet can't be opened, has lost its tab or its columns, or needs a manager. Told once for each change.

leadMetaAdded.label: Many leads from Facebook or Instagram are given to you
leadMetaAdded.hint: When a catch-up brings you more than five lead ad leads at once, in one message. Fewer arrive one by one, as "A lead is given to you".

metaNeedsAttention.label: A Facebook Page needs attention
metaNeedsAttention.hint: When we can't read leads from a connected Page any more, its access is about to end, or a lead form gained a question. Told once for each change.

metaNewForm.label: A lead came from a form you haven't brought in
metaNewForm.hint: When a lead arrives from a lead form that isn't brought in yet. Told once for each form; the lead is kept for when you bring it in.

importFinished.label: An import of yours ends
importFinished.hint: When the rows of a file you imported have been added, or the import stopped.

exportReady.label: An export you asked for is ready
exportReady.hint: When the file of leads or staff you asked for can be downloaded.

formBusy.label: Your website form is busy
formBusy.hint: When your website form gets more enquiries than usual and has been slowed. Told once an hour.

whatsappMessage.label: A customer writes on WhatsApp
whatsappMessage.hint: When a customer with an open lead of yours sends a message. A burst of messages is one notice.

whatsappPastCustomer.label: A past customer writes on WhatsApp
whatsappPastCustomer.hint: When someone whose leads are all closed writes, so you can answer or start a new lead.

whatsappNeedsAttention.label: WhatsApp needs your attention
whatsappNeedsAttention.hint: When a template is rejected, WhatsApp's daily limit for new chats is reached, or storage is too full to keep customers' files.

whatsappSendFailed.label: Your WhatsApp message wasn't sent
whatsappSendFailed.hint: When a reply you sent from the inbox could not be delivered, so you can try again.

inboxMentioned.label: A teammate mentions you in a chat
inboxMentioned.hint: When someone writes @ and your name in a team note.

inboxSnoozeEnded.label: A chat you snoozed comes back
inboxSnoozeEnded.hint: At the time you chose when you snoozed it.

salesHotLead.label: A lead is hot: they opened the quote again or asked to book
salesHotLead.hint: So you call while they are deciding.

salesPaymentDue.label: A customer's payment is due or missed
salesPaymentDue.hint: We remind them on WhatsApp too, when Sales automation's reminders are on.

aiHandoff.label: The AI assistant handed a chat to you
aiHandoff.hint: When a customer wants to book, pay, bargain or talk to a person.

aiBooking.label: The AI assistant took a booking
aiBooking.hint: When a customer says yes to a trip in a chat the AI answers.

aiPaymentProof.label: A customer sent a payment screenshot
aiPaymentProof.hint: When a customer whose booking waits for payment sends a photo or PDF.

preferences.noEmail: You sign in without an email address, so no email is sent to you.
preferences.impersonating: Only {name} can change these: what reaches them is their choice.

push.heading: On this device
push.label: Push notifications
push.onHint: This device shows a notification when something reaches you by push.
push.offHint: Turn it on to get push notifications on this device. Your browser asks you first.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications. On an iPhone or iPad, add the app to your Home Screen and open it from there.
push.noWorker: This page hasn't started the app's offline support, which push needs. Reload the page and try again.
push.blocked: Your browser blocks notifications from this app. Allow them in the browser's settings for this site, then reload the page.
push.failed: This browser couldn't turn push on. Try again in a moment.
push.impersonating: Support can't turn push on for {name}: it would reach support's device, not theirs.
push.fallbackBody: Open the app to see what happened.

team.title: Team notifications
team.intro: Choose who on your team gets emails, and who gets a copy of every important alert.
team.emailMeaning: Email: the person gets their notifications by email too, not only in the app and on their phone.
team.copiesMeaning: Copy of team alerts: the person also hears about every booking, payment screenshot, hot lead, unassigned lead and chat the AI needs help with, even when the lead isn't theirs.
team.own: Each person can still turn kinds off for themselves in <link>their notifications</link>.
team.membersDescription: Bookings and payment screenshots are always emailed to the lead's owner and to whoever manages settings.
team.noEmail: No email address: signs in with a username
